code:
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm \
  --alarm-name high-cpu-web01 \
  --metric-name CPUUtilization \
  --period 300 --evaluation-periods 1 \
  --threshold 80 \
  --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold \
  --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:...:ops-alerts
caption: CPUUtilization above 80% for a 5-minute period — no one has to be watching the chart.

eyebrow: SNS: where the alarm actually publishes
code:
aws sns create-topic --name ops-alerts

aws sns subscribe \
  --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:...:ops-alerts \
  --protocol email \
  --notification-endpoint oncall@example.com
caption: A new subscription sits "pending confirmation" until the subscriber clicks the link.
